transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the foundation's offer of 18 used musical instruments for our student music programs. I'll be making the final decision on whether to accept the donation and approve the handling plan, but I want to make sure we go through our routine process properly before I sign off. The draft plan currently proposes accepting all 18 instruments, placing them in the central music storeroom, and making them available after a basic checkout entry. Before I approve anything, I'd like to hear from those of you who have relevant expertise or concerns. Who would like to start?

I haven't yet attached the insurer's confirmation to the approval packet, but I'll make sure to do that.
